ip netns add slw-07534e10c0
ip link add slw07534e10c0h type veth peer name up0 netns slw-07534e10c0
ip addr add 10.200.0.5/30 dev slw07534e10c0h
ip link set dev slw07534e10c0h up
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 link set dev lo up
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 addr add 10.200.0.6/30 dev up0
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 link set dev up0 up
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 route add default via 10.200.0.5 dev up0
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 tuntap add dev tap0 mode tap
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 addr add 172.16.0.1/30 dev tap0
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 link set dev tap0 mtu 1500 up
ip netns exec slw-07534e10c0 sysctl -q -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
ip -n slw-07534e10c0 route add 172.17.0.0/16 via 172.16.0.2 dev tap0
ip netns exec slw-07534e10c0 nft -f - <<ruleset
table inet davit_guest {
	set host4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 192.168.1.10/32 }
	}
	set host6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set svc4 {
		type ipv4_addr . inet_proto . inet_service
		elements = { 192.168.7.20 . tcp . 5432 }
	}
	set allow4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set allow6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set deny4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 0.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12, 192.0.0.0/24, 192.168.0.0/16, 198.18.0.0/15, 224.0.0.0/4, 240.0.0.0/4 }
	}
	set deny6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { ::/128, ::1/128, ::ffff:0.0.0.0/96, 64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48, 2001::/32, 2002::/16, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8 }
	}
	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state established,related accept
		ct state invalid drop
		iifname != "tap0" drop
		oifname != "up0" drop
		meta nfproto ipv6 drop
		ip saddr != { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } drop
		ip daddr @host4 drop
		ip6 daddr @host6 drop
		ip daddr . meta l4proto . th dport @svc4 accept
		ip daddr @allow4 accept
		ip6 daddr @allow6 accept
		ip daddr @deny4 drop
		ip6 daddr @deny6 drop
		accept
	}
	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		iifname "tap0" ct state established,related accept
		iifname "tap0" ip saddr { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } ip daddr 172.16.0.1 tcp dport 15080 accept
		iifname "tap0" drop
	}
	chain postrouting {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		oifname "up0" ip saddr { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } masquerade
	}
}
ruleset
nft -f - <<ruleset
add element inet davit vm_src { "slw07534e10c0h" . 10.200.0.6 }
ruleset
